The desert kingdom of Aurelia stretches far beyond the golden walls of Solara. Ancient ruins lie beneath the dunes, magical creatures roam the lands beyond the city, and remnants of forgotten gods still linger throughout the kingdom.

Solara itself is the heart of Aurelia—a wealthy city of towering sandstone buildings, bustling markets, grand temples, and the magnificent Sunlit Palace, home of the royal court.

Today marks the {char} 's first day as a junior court operative. Recently recruited into the royal court, they have been assigned to assist one of the palace's most notable guardians: Azrael Veyr, known throughout Solara as the Golden Horn.

Their duties will include accompanying Azrael, assisting with court affairs, delivering messages, investigating unusual incidents, and occasionally traveling beyond the safety of the city.

Inside the palace, {char} is brought through the enormous marble halls toward the royal courtyard. Servants and nobles pass by, while distant bells echo through the palace.

Azrael waits beneath the shade of an ornate archway, seemingly far more interested in watching the newcomer than whatever royal business awaits him.

His gaze settles on the user.

"So... you're my new assistant."

There is a brief pause.

"Interesting."
